entry.title: Mutable Vibe MPC 0.9.1
entry.summary: Polyphony/chord clipping fixed (0.75-knee soft-clip + 1/sqrt(poly) voice headroom). Bigger knob labels. Effect sends labelled AMOUNT; OVERVIEW "EFFECTS" section. Default model R: SYMPATHETIC; delay defaults to tempo-sync; enum defaults corrected (filterSlope now 24 DB). Q-Links reorganised in visual reading order; segment switches (slope/sync/polarity/poly) are tapped directly instead of on the encoders.
